description: Saves a segment (a group of contacts defined by rules) the store can send campaigns to, and says how many subscribers are in it now ("fewer than 10" for small groups). Rules use the same shape as count_audience and list_segments: { match: "all" | "any", rules: [...] }, with the same limits (no rules on names, emails or postcodes). Check the size with count_audience first.
name: create_segment
title: Create a segment
